question: When and where must the practitioner remain composed during the cremation-ground rite?
premises: The rite occurs at midnight on kula-aṣṭamī.
The practitioner sits in the middle of the pyre.
inference: The practitioner must be composed at midnight on kula-aṣṭamī in the pyre's middle.
uncertainties: Exact sense of kula-aṣṭamī is not specified in this chunk.
plain_english: At midnight on kula-aṣṭamī, in the middle of the pyre, he is composed.
